title: Mochizuki Honami — With A Side Of Compassion〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: ...and Ms. Yoisaki's is straight ahead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm starting to get nervous...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, was it really okay for me to ask her to teach me more about making music using digital tools?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sure Ms. Yoisaki would've said something if she was really busy or wouldn't be available.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right...
Still, I'm pretty nervous about going over to her house.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What are we supposed to talk about first? Where do I even start? Should I thank her for agreeing to help me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hey... You could be helping me instead of laughing, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Starting out by thanking her seems perfectly fine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I knew it!
After that, I should explain what my song's supposed to be about, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Then, you two should go up to her room to work on it together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: While you do, I'll be cleaning the living room and preparing some food. Feel free to ask if you ever need anything, okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'll try not to bother you too much, Honami, since you're going over to do work.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, keeping you from cleaning and making food for Kanade wouldn't be fair to her either.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you've actually been helping for some time now by carrying half of the grocery bags for me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, this is something I should be doing anyway!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At the same time, we bought so much... Rice, vegetables... I was under the impression that you'd cook using whatever ingredients were available at Kanade's house.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I do that sometimes, but she really doesn't do much grocery shopping outside of buying instant noodles...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Whenever I go over, the refrigerator's usually empty.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Asahina told me a little about her the other day, but I'm starting to understand why you're worried about her eating properly each day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Fortunately, the dishes I leave in the refrigerator are usually all gone by my next visit, so she does seem to be eating properly lately.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have to think that the food you make is so good that she can't help but eat it all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That would make me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You also come up with menus for each day, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. My goals for those involve nutritional balance and including ingredients that are in season.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I usually think about what to make each day when I visit the grocery store before heading over to her house.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That means... You have to think about what to make while shopping, clean her house when you get there, cook... That sounds like a lot.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It is. However, I also secretly give myself a pat on the back whenever I'm able to cook or clean in a timely manner.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's so you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, the way Ms. Yoisaki shows surprise at how clean her room becomes or smiles because she likes something I make puts a big smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This job seems to really suit you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe so too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: By the way, what's your plan for today?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll be cooking pot-au-feu and pumpkin croquettes for dinner. After that, I'm going to make some mushroom rice for later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, they had salmon and cod roe on sale, so I'm thinking about making some rice balls for you two to have while you work.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds really nice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, we've only been talking about food... I'm supposed to be learning from her about using digital tools for music.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Actually, I'm glad we did.
You seem a little less nervous now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I hope we get to talk a lot.
There's just so much that I want to ask her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll have plenty of time to do just that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But being taught one on one like this is...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
...?
Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami, once we arrive at Kanade's house, you have to get to work right away...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which means... I'm going to be alone with Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...
Oh no. I'm getting nervous again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then... Why don't we talk more about food?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. No problem. Besides the mushroom rice, I plan on making a different rice dish...
